title: FEATURE — Auto-write/clear data/rapidapi-lapse.json from rapidapi-tiktok-client.ts
rationale: data/rapidapi-lapse.json was pre-seeded manually by Sprint 1371 and has a 24h TTL for /status and /blockers warnings. This breaks the automation loop — if the subscription lapses again in the future, nobody writes the file and the operator gets no warning. Fix: add markRapidApiLapse() and clearRapidApiLapse() helpers to rapidapi-tiktok-client.ts. Call markRapidApiLapse() on 403 in searchByKeyword(), getTrendingFeed(), and getVideoInfo(). Call clearRapidApiLapse() on success so the file is removed when the subscription is renewed.

tasks.description: Add markRapidApiLapse() (writes data/rapidapi-lapse.json) and clearRapidApiLapse() (deletes it) to scripts/scs001/rapidapi-tiktok-client.ts. Call mark on 403 in searchByKeyword, getTrendingFeed, getVideoInfo. Call clear on success path in all 3. This closes the automation loop for /status and /blockers lapse warnings.
